notes: Preserves official nvm installer with METHOD=script, downloading nvm.sh/nvm-exec/bash_completion locally. Installs pinned official Node.js tarball into nvm's version layout and sets default with nvm itself. Avoids calling online nvm install/version discovery. nvm future versions and npm package installation require separate resources.

Clean Ubuntu test exposed Node 26 libatomic.so.1 dependency. Bundle includes Ubuntu libatomic1 deb with archive SHA-256, extracts its library into the private Node prefix and uses a Node launcher with process-local LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Requires dpkg-deb; tested on Ubuntu 26.04, not arbitrary distributions. Original Node binary is preserved as node.real.
